gen-zen-dots-gf-ar-one-sans: Zen Dots gives every letter generous space around it, a techy, friendly heading that never feels cramped. AR One Sans follows, its brush-lifted curve ends keeping a long page of text moving smoothly.
gen-zen-dots-gf-assistant: Techy, friendly, and open all over. Assistant keeps its mouths wide on c, e and a, so the pair's strongest quality is how easily Zen Dots' generous shapes hand off to a plain sans.
gen-zen-dots-gf-asta-sans: Zen Dots spaces its letters generously, giving the heading a techy, friendly look with low hairline contrast. Asta Sans runs tubelike and constant beside it.
gen-zen-dots-gf-bai-jamjuree: Zen Dots leads with a techy, friendly display voice, while Bai Jamjuree answers in round letters that feel light and unpinched. Its strokes never swell or thin, so a long passage flows steadily.
gen-zen-dots-gf-barlow: Zen Dots sets a friendly, techy tone with roomy letter shapes, and Barlow draws neon-tube strokes below it. Make the heading small or the body large, and that difference softens.
gen-zen-dots-gf-biz-udgothic: BIZ UDGothic reads modern and businesslike, with a wide channel into every bowl. Zen Dots above it adds a techy, friendly display voice, and the sans-serif text settles in underneath without any fuss.
gen-zen-dots-gf-bpmf-huninn: Techy up top, outline-soft below. Bpmf Huninn gives the sans-serif body a thin tubing feel, and its wide bowl channels fit neatly against the generous shapes of Zen Dots.
gen-zen-dots-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Zen Dots stands out for the generous space around each letter. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std adds subtle stroke swelling in its curves, so a longer passage feels gently human instead of mechanical.
gen-zen-dots-gf-cairo: Zen Dots leaves generous room around every letter, giving the heading a techy, friendly face. Cairo's wide channel into each bowl keeps a longer passage of sans text flowing smoothly beneath it.
gen-zen-dots-gf-cambay: Techy, friendly, and spaced out generously. Cambay's rounds gap open like a cracked bangle, and a longer passage in its sans-serif text moves along with a light, modern step.
